system.notes:
Linen-wrapped pharaoh, eyes burning with malice and diabolic light.

AC 14, HP 56, ATK 3 rot touch +8 (1d10 + necrosis) or 1 spell +8, MV near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I +3, W +2, Ch +4, AL C, LV 12

Conjure Skeletons (CHA Spell). DC 14. Summon 1d6 loyal skeletons that appear within near. They stay for 5 rounds.

Desiccated. Can be damaged by fire. Takes x2 damage from it.

Necrosis. CON 15+ or drop to 0 HP. Healing spells are DC 15 to cast on target while at 0 HP due to this effect.

Sandstorm (CHA Spell). DC 13. Sandstorm fills a double- near-sized cube centered on mummy. It spreads around corners. Mortals inside the fog are blinded.

Slay Living (CHA Spell). DC 15. 5d10 damage to one enemy within far of mummy.

Supreme Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by magical sources.
